# truenas_zvol (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS zvol by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full zvol path, e.g. tank/myvol.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `compression` (String)
- `dedup` (String)
- `encrypted` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pool` (String)
- `sparse` (Boolean)
- `sync` (String)
- `volblocksize` (Number)
- `volsize` (Number)
